color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Orchestrator
any sub-agent failure past the DLQ threshold parks the review
in NEEDS_HUMAN with a card explaining what stalled.
It never invents a missing answer and never approves

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Questionnaire
unparseable replies are quoted back to the analyst queue.
Three chases without a response ends the loop

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evidence
unreadable or corrupt documents produce a needs_human finding
with the file reference — never a silent skip. A document that
fails screening never reaches this agent at all

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Risk Scorer
scoring is arithmetic over model-assigned severities and makes
no model call at all, so a malformed finding fails loudly
rather than quietly skewing a score

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Watchdog
a feed outage logs and skips.
It never blocks or degrades an active review

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
One principle underneath all of it
a security product that guesses is worse
than one that stops. Every path here ends
with a human being told what happened —
never with the fleet quietly choosing
an answer for them

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Message poisoning → DLQ after five delivery attempts
→ NEEDS_HUMAN card on the dashboard

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Invalid state transition → raises, lands in
NEEDS_HUMAN, never silently corrects

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Crash between claim and effect → an in_progress record
older than the timeout is surfaced for reconciliation.
For email the safe default is do not resend, flag for confirmation

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Half-configured startup → config.py validates with Pydantic
at import and fails loudly. A service that boots half-configured
produces the worst class of demo failure

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
OPTIONAL controls degrade. Scrubber unavailable → warning,
proceed with the screened text. Embedding or KNN index unavailable →
warning, whole-document fallback. Neither is ever on the critical path

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MANDATORY controls fail closed. Model Armor unavailable →
nothing is promoted out of quarantine, no model receives external
content, affected reviews park in NEEDS_HUMAN with a card.
A skipped detector is treated as unscreened, not as clean

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
Late or out-of-order event → a reply after SCORED attaches as an
addendum and reopens the score; evidence.screened before a plan parks and
retries; watchdog.hit deduplicates on signal id; any event for a DECIDED
review appends and never mutates. Pub/Sub guarantees delivery, not sequence

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
Cost ceiling exceeded → the review parks in NEEDS_HUMAN with a
cost card and model calls stop. Budgets are enforced, not observed

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GEAP component unavailable in your region → the same contract
behind the existing interface, stated plainly in the README and the
video. A judge respects a labelled substitution, not a false claim

svg.text: Drawbridge — Failure semantics: every agent documents what it does when things break
